description: Feeling unable to cope because there is too much to deal with.
translation: Sentirse abrumado porque hay demasiadas cosas que manejar.
example: I felt overwhelmed with work this week.

description: To delay or postpone doing something that needs to be done.
translation: Posponer o aplazar algo que se debe hacer.
example: I always procrastinate before starting a big project.

description: To mention or introduce a topic in a conversation.
translation: Mencionar o sacar un tema en una conversación.
example: She brought up an interesting point during the meeting.

description: Simple and easy to understand or do, without complications.
translation: Sencillo y fácil de entender o hacer, sin complicaciones.
example: The instructions were straightforward, so I finished quickly.

word: TO GET THE HANG OF IT
description: To learn how to do something after practicing it.
translation: Agarrarle la onda o dominar algo después de practicarlo.
example: It took me a while, but I finally got the hang of it.
